summary: Test whether padding each ISA circuit with the idle of a local list schedule under the execution Target lowers the exact model's TV distance to hardware on the retained dynamic IBM runs, before live_run's planner adopts it (issue 526).

reconciliation.note: Issue 526 states the proposal and falsifier; the encoded N=21 idle replay is the single-run precedent.

scope: A local ASAP padding function in gororoba_quantum/, its single-run calibration against the service-padded N=21 replay, and a paired padded-versus-unpadded exact-law TVD comparison over the eligible ghost-run members under each member's execution snapshot. Planner wiring follows only if the falsifier passes.
next_action: Assemble result.json from the idle-falsifier workflow's per-run parts with --parts-only, fill the README falsifier tail and gate names, then compute the inserted-replica estimate.

steps.action: Write a function that pads an ISA circuit with explicit delays from an as-soon-as-possible list schedule under Target durations, cursor starting at each qubit's first instruction.
steps.acceptance: Its per-qubit inserted idle equals scheduled_idle_replay.list_schedule_idle on every replica of the encoded N=21 run.

steps.action: Compute the locally padded exact contrast of the encoded N=21 Kingston run (results/live/2026-10-18T090603.530638Z) under the execution Target.
steps.acceptance: The locally padded exact contrast and arm TVDs are recorded beside the service-padded values (-0.0007; 0.0129 and 0.0158). A contrast near the unpadded +0.0310 stops the sweep: local placement misplaces the idle.

steps.action: Over every non-skipped run in docs/evidence/ghost_runs/report.json that holds a dynamic member, compute per replica TVD(measured, padded exact) minus TVD(measured, unpadded exact) under the execution snapshot; report per run the mean difference, its standard error and the replica count.
steps.acceptance: Pass when a strict majority of eligible runs has a negative mean difference; every run whose mean difference exceeds two standard errors above zero is listed. A failure refuses the planner change, as issue 526 states.

receipts.result: Issue 526's rule passes over the 35 audited runs: 13 of 20 eligible runs have a negative mean d and none lies two standard errors above zero; --check reproduces the PR and full-tier gate runs with largest deviation 0.0 on the build host.

steps.action: If the sweep passes, record padded and unpadded predictions side by side in live_run's plan and run the live_run.py dry run.
steps.acceptance: The dry run's record carries both predictions and the approved-record comparison is unchanged for an unpadded record.

steps.action: Beside the preregistered decision, report per run the mean d over only the replicas into which idle_padding.pad inserts idle, with its standard error and count, and list the runs and replicas with no inserted idle (d exactly 0 by construction), labeled as a secondary analysis that leaves issue 526's verdict unchanged.
steps.acceptance: result.json or a sibling file carries the conditional means for every scored run; the README states that runs 2026-10-21T043156 and 2026-10-21T064222 and the three one-qubit controls insert no idle, and gives the inserted-idle replica counts of 2026-10-26T202817 (372 of 1364), 2026-10-27T160530 (390 of 1320) and 2026-10-27T173602 (988 of 1064) from the replicas' inserted_dt.
steps.reason: Zero-insertion runs and replicas enter the preregistered rule as d = 0 and count as not lower, so the rule measures dilution beside padding.

receipts.result: inserted.json restricts each run to the replicas whose padded law differs: all 13 runs with such replicas are lower; seven runs change no law (no wait, or idle on a qubit reset to |0>), as the README states with the insertion counts.
